partner_sources.scope: semidefinite rank-two projection density <=2pi/sqrt(P); collective Schur pair-log compiler
partner_sources.application: block-independent owner-target Q=2XY+(r.Z)^2+(s.Z)^2 sharpened to C0 with height <=2pi

proved_claims: partner semidefinite constant 2pi is sharp in the general rank-two product class
exact rank-three uniform target can have a sqrt boundary cusp and fail every local Holder exponent alpha>1/2

key_formulas.same_height_compiler: if ||f_R||inf<=K and H is independent AC with density g, then p_(R+H)=f_R*g in C0, ||p||inf<=K, and ||tau_h p-p||inf<=K||tau_h g-g||1
key_formulas.block_semidefinite: A=S direct_sum B, rank(S)=2 semidefinite, B!=0 => ||p_Q||inf<=2pi/sqrt(|sigma1 sigma2|) and p_Q in C0
key_formulas.actual_partner_application: Q=2XY+(r.Z)^2+(s.Z)^2, r,s orthonormal => ||p_Q||inf<=2pi and p_Q in C0
key_formulas.sharp_rank2: R=((X1+X2)/sqrt2)^2+((X3+X4)/sqrt2)^2 has p_R(t)=2pi-8sqrt(2t)+4t for 0<t<1/2, so ess sup=2pi and no continuous representative
key_formulas.rank3_cusp: T=R+V^2 has p_T(t)=4pi sqrt(t)-4pi sqrt(2)t+(16/3)t^(3/2) for 0<t<1/4; hence p_T~4pi sqrt(t)

unresolved_implication: General A has cross-couplings between candidate height and smoothing blocks, so the same-height convolution compiler cannot be applied. The full proof still needs a product-preserving aggregate-before-inversion/ridge/grouped reduction that creates or retains a genuinely independent smoothing resource in original coordinates.
next_step: Try to extend the same-height C0 mechanism to a controlled nonzero cross-coupling via conditioning/Schur decomposition without taking a worst-fiber supremum; preserve a jointly averaged smoothing resource.
